description: Vulnerability trend for a vendor (optionally one product) from the NIST NVD: CVEs published in the last N days (default 7, up to 120; a big vendor over a long window can take NVD 30+ seconds) naming the vendor (or mapped to its CPE with match=cpe), counts by severity, average and maximum CVSS score, CVEs per week, top CWE weaknesses and the highest-scored CVEs with score, severity, vector, date and description. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

match.description: keyword (default: vendor/product words in the CVE text) or cpe (only CVEs NVD has mapped to the vendor CPE)

product.description: Optional CPE product name, e.g. windows_11_24h2, http_server, fortios

top.description: How many top-scored CVEs to list, 1 to 50 (default 10)

vendor.description: CPE vendor name, e.g. microsoft, apache, cisco, fortinet (required)

name: security_cve_details_feed
title: Security Cve Details Feed
